_comment: AGENT-EDITABLE sizing policy. Hard caps live in config/protected.json and always win.
sizing_notes: Flat $5. min_edge lowered 0.07->0.04 for the data-collection phase (cycle 1): with zero settled positions, loop count and calibration data are worth more than per-bet EV. Revisit at n>=50 settled.
edge_class_notes: DEEP-2026-07-31: min_edge_book_devig (0.07 = 0.04 base + ~0.03 buffer covering proportional-devig longshot bias (~0.5-1.5c measured on entry odds), scraped-line staleness, and the sharp-counterparty prior on tight books; at n=7 the buffer size is a judgment call) applies to edges derived solely from devigging scraped bookmaker odds against a tight PM book — that class went 0/7 while structural edges went 2/2. Structural edges (information race, cross-market inconsistency) keep min_edge 0.04. max_stake_per_event_usd caps correlated sibling/derivative legs on one underlying event (evidence: CONN@CHI spread+ML -$10, and two open $10 pairs). If book-devig placements drop to ~zero, revisit whether 0.07 should apply only to proportional-devig numbers (power devig already removes the bias). DEEP-2026-08-01: kept 0.07 — the 24h placement drought was candidate supply/researchability, not the threshold (max clean devig edge seen 0.045). min_edge_wide_book (0.30) is the ask-edge floor for the narrow info-race exception to max_spread (playbook §Spread-rule scope): max_spread stays a hard veto for book-devig/benchmark bets; info-race bets held to resolution may exceed it only at ask-edge >= 0.30 with the spread explicitly logged. Evidence: structural wins came from 0.01-0.06-spread books, all 7 book-devig losses from 1c books; b21e42c123a1 (spread 0.13, placed without logging it) is the violation on record that forced the scope decision. DEEP-2026-08-02: 0.07 kept a second day — it blocked zero bets (only clean same-book devig found in ~28 cycles: Pirates/Reds FanDuel, max edge 0.009; every other candidate failed on benchmark reachability, ~20 odds domains returning 403). The 2026-07-31 watch item stays open but is blocked on restoring benchmark access (operator proposal, DEEP-2026-08-02 e.2), not on threshold evidence. RETRO-2026-08-02-1412: first book-devig settlement under the power-devig fix WON (`509650e5ec31`, edge 0.10 at the 0.07 floor, power devig + independent-model corroboration + tight 0.01-spread book). n=1, keeps 0.07 unchanged, but the fix's first real test came back positive rather than purely theoretical. DEEP-2026-08-03: no numeric changes. Honest-state note for the structural class (which keeps min_edge 0.04): settled 2W/0L, but all 3 open structural positions are marked adversely (b21e42c123a1 mid ~0.045 vs 0.15 entry; d2dd24206542 No mid ~0.395 vs 0.92; 84ec821167d5 No mid ~0.02 vs 0.16) — if they settle as marked the class goes 2W/3L and its 0.04 floor gets re-examined with settled evidence; playbook gained a fact-finality requirement and a sibling-market validity test (method errors found in 84ec821167d5's rationale, enacted outcome-independent). DEEP-2026-08-04: no numeric changes (n=16 settled justifies none). 84ec821167d5 settled LOST -$5 and the pre-registered grading was applied (method error, not variance) — structural class is now 2W/2L by decision, with the split exactly on fact finality: both wins were mechanical/final facts (2dc417ed68f6 official print, 1e8dec1078ba cross-market), both losses provisional or interpretation-dependent ones (ai-leaderboard pair as one decision, 84ec821167d5). Iran pair still open and marked adversely (b21e42c123a1 Yes mid ~0.022 vs 0.15; d2dd24206542 No mid ~0.475 vs 0.92, oscillating 0.355-0.545); if settled as marked the class goes 2W/4L and min_edge 0.04 for info-race gets re-examined on settled evidence. min_edge_book_devig 0.07 blocked zero bets for a third window (max clean same-line devig edge seen ~0.028, Tempo/Valkyries) — still untested rather than restrictive; unblocking is the reachability proposal, not the threshold. DEEP-2026-08-05: no numeric changes (n=17). b21e42c123a1 settled LOST -$5 (normal UMA flow, resolver waited out the 3-day conflicting-reports clause) — structural class now 2W/3L by decision, split still exactly on fact finality. Its loss was not threshold-related (nominal edge 0.75 at entry) but fact-quality; enacted the pre-registered tightening of the min_edge_wide_book exception instead (playbook: wide-spread info-race now also requires a final/mechanical fact confirmed by a non-party primary source). d2dd24206542 still open (No mid ~0.215 vs 0.92 entry, no UMA proposal ever submitted); if it settles as marked the class goes 2W/4L and the state-media rule enacts per DEEP-2026-08-02. min_edge_book_devig 0.07 blocked zero bets a fourth window (max clean edge 0.0195, GS Valkyries) — still untested. DEEP-2026-08-06: no numeric changes (n=18). Book-devig post-power-devig-fix is 2W/0L (509650e5ec31 edge 0.10; 2363018c118b edge 0.0795, WON +$5, first edge_class-stamped row — score.py by_edge_class shows book-devig brier_delta -0.0732 at stamped n=1). min_edge_book_devig 0.07 became BINDING for the first time: ~10 clean power-devig edges 0.003-0.050 skipped this window per funnel.jsonl (largest 0.050, A's/Reds total) — the floor's cost is now measured rather than hypothetical; kept unchanged at n=2 post-fix wins, since both wins cleared 0.07 with margin and the blocked 0.02-0.05 band on tight MLB books is exactly the sharp-counterparty zone that produced the 0/7 record. Overall z improved -2.61 -> -2.31 with the win; legacy overconfidence read unchanged. d2dd24206542 still open (No mid ~0.155 vs 0.92 entry, no UMA proposal, 6 days past end date); state-media pre-registration unchanged. DEEP-2026-08-07: no numeric changes (n=19). First 'other'-class settlement LOST (d6d71ab454dc WTI, est 0.88, edge 0.17 claimed, brier_delta +0.2703 at stamped n=1) -- it passed every written threshold (edge 0.17 >= 0.04, spread 0.06 <= max 0.06), so the gap was in the rulebook, not compliance; patched via the playbook outside-view veto: claimed edge > 0.10 is 0W/5L brier_delta +0.4587 across all settled history vs +0.0041 for claimed edge <= 0.10 (6W/8L, market-level). min_edge_book_devig 0.07 non-binding this window (clean MLB devig edges 0.00-0.022, all under even min_edge). z now -2.73 on n=19; the overconfidence lives almost entirely in the large-claimed-edge cohort. DEEP-2026-08-08: no numeric changes (n=19, nothing settled this window; 35 researched candidates, 0 bets -- no-edge 18, benchmark-unreachable 15, budget-exhausted 2 per funnel.jsonl). d2dd24206542 has converged (gamma Yes 0.895/No 0.105, still no UMA proposal, 8 days past end date): if it settles as marked, info-race goes 2W/4L and the state-media rule enacts (pre-registration unchanged). BLS ladder skip graded against the actual print (4.1%): the final noise-read candidate (4.1% No at edge 0.04, the min_edge floor exactly) would have lost -- first outcome evidence that at-the-floor edges on thin two-venue divergences are noise; min_edge 0.04 itself unchanged, but see playbook rule that a cross-venue divergence needs a mechanical anchor to count as a benchmark. min_edge_book_devig 0.07 non-binding again (clean devig edges this window 0.008-0.05, most under even min_edge). DEEP-2026-08-09: no numeric changes (n=19, nothing settled this window; 31 researched, 0 bets -- benchmark-unreachable 21, no-edge 8, market-agrees 1, budget-exhausted 1 per funnel.jsonl). First CLEAN-FEED test of the book-devig floors (core/odds.py live, 2026-08-09 02:12Z): 9 devigged markets, max nominal edge 0.018 at the mid -- min_edge_book_devig 0.07 non-binding and min_edge 0.04 non-binding on every clean line; the floor has still never blocked a clean-feed bet, so it stays. Interpretation recorded in playbook (Odds-API section): clean lines show ~0.02 gaps to tight PM books; the historical 0.10+ 'edges' were scraped-line artifacts. d2dd24206542 unchanged (No mid ~0.155 vs 0.92 entry, 9 days past end date, no UMA proposal); state-media pre-registration unchanged. DEEP-2026-08-10: no numeric changes (bet n=19, nothing settled this window; 0 bets across 8 full cycles -- all researched candidates no-edge/market-agrees/outside-view-veto per funnel.jsonl). Forecast ledger's first scored window: n=18 settled at brier_delta +0.001 (all no-edge skips, at-market by construction); threshold sweep empty -- no settled forecast yet carries ask-edge >= 0.02, so every risk.json floor remains untested by the forecast stream too. Floors non-binding again (max clean-feed devig edge seen 0.020 across the window's sweeps). First out-of-sample tests of the >0.10 outside-view veto are queued as forecast rows (WI Hong brackets claimed edges 0.052-0.117 settle ~Aug 11; PLBY claimed 0.14 settles Aug 10 night) -- grade them against the veto when settled. d2dd24206542 mid decayed 0.155 -> 0.095, 10 days past end date, still no UMA proposal; pre-registration unchanged. DEEP-2026-08-11: no numeric changes (bet n=19, nothing settled; 0 bets across 6 full cycles, all researched edges under floor -- max clean-feed devig edge 0.035, STL -1.5). First out-of-sample >0.10-veto test settled: PLBY declined at claimed edge 0.14 (est 0.33 vs ask 0.19), resolved No -- the veto saved a $5 loss (instance one). Threshold sweep's first settled bucket: edge_min 0.02/0.03, n=1 (PLBY at recorded edge 0.03), ROI -1.0 -- the only settled forecast disagreement so far went to the market, consistent with the bet-side z=-2.73 overconfidence pattern; zero settled instances anywhere of being right against the market. WI/SC/MN primary rows (claimed edges 0.052-0.27) settle 2026-08-11 night and CPI Aug 12 -- the floors and the veto get their first real multi-row test there; grade before touching any number. DEEP-2026-08-12: no numeric changes (bet n=19, nothing settled this window; 1 bet placed 2026-08-11, b35963f465b4 PPI<=5.1% Yes @0.78, edge 0.06, spread 0.02, edge_class other, compliant with every floor, settles with the Aug 13 BLS print). The pre-registered primary batch graded provisionally against on-chain prices (UMA pending): outside-view veto now 6-for-6 with zero over-fires (PLBY + WI>=30% bracket + SC Nordone claimed 0.27 + SC Fry 0.196 + MN Craig 0.15 + MN Flanagan ~0.195), every decided disagreement went to the market, batch brier_delta ~ +0.058 over 13 rows against us. Floors otherwise non-binding this window (clean-feed devig edges 0.0008-0.0095). d2dd24206542 mid ~0.024, 12 days past end date, no UMA proposal; state-media pre-registration unchanged.
